subject: [PATCH 42/60] mm: fail private placement on exhaustion instead of OOM killing

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series addresses issues related to private memory allocation in the Linux kernel. The primary goal is to modify the behavior of the OOM (Out-Of-Memory) killer when dealing with private memory, which belongs to a device or specialized service and has a fixed pool size. Instead of selecting an OOM victim, the allocation should fail immediately. This change aims to prevent incorrect blame assignment and improve system stability.
